title: Core Calculator UI and Form Submission
user_story: As a user, I want a plain HTML UI served at the root route / with two number inputs, an operation picker for add/subtract/multiply/divide, and a Calculate button, so that I can prepare my calculation request.
acceptance_criteria: The page loads at the root route / with a plain HTML UI.
Two number inputs are present on the page.
A way to pick one of the four basic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) is available.
A Calculate button submits the form.

title: Server-Side Calculation and Result Display
user_story: As a user, I want submitting the form to compute the result server-side and re-render the page with a labeled result area, so that I can see my calculation outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting the form computes the result server-side.
The page re-renders with a labeled result area showing the computed value.

title: Division by Zero Error Handling
user_story: As a user, I want division by zero to show an error message instead of crashing, so that the app remains stable and minimal.
acceptance_criteria: Division by zero shows an error message instead of crashing.
Keep it minimal: no auth, no database, no JS frameworks.
